summary: Exited at +59.25pts (t=7m) after the trade ran to a +180pt peak amplitude and gave back 25%. The exit signature was a convergence of decay signals: ER10 trend-efficiency dropped from 0.92 to 0.68 in one bar, and the against-position fires clustered from one (KMDR) to three simultaneous (KMDR+HA+PROPP), where PROPP flipped from a with-position fire to against. Next time I'd watch for this same combo -- efficiency-ratio breakdown plus multi-signal fire clustering against the position -- earlier and weight it more than raw giveback percentage alone, since giveback stayed in a tolerable range (9-21%) for several bars before the real reversal signature appeared.
